description: AMIU Puglia publishes the locations and service schedules of mobile waste-collection centres in the municipality of Bari, Italy. The metadata describes temporary collection stations distributed across city neighbourhoods, with opening days, service hours and accepted waste categories. CSV and JSON resources list station locations, neighbourhoods and geographic coordinates; a CSV dictionary is also listed. These facility and schedule attributes can provide inputs for waste-service capacity planning, although vehicle capacities and household demand are not established. The catalogue metadata was modified on 15 July 2026; the represented service period and coordinate reference system are unspecified. The provider states Creative Commons Attribution without a licence version. Cost and download access conditions remain unverified. Only the public metadata page and resource descriptions were checked; no data file was downloaded. The related fixed-centre record describes permanent collection facilities and their delivery rules.
